adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, blacklist entries are normalized to lowercase (`BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS.split(...).map(email => email.toLowerCase())`), but the filter checks `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` without lowercasing `guest`. This makes the blacklist comparison case-sensitive and allows bypass with case variants like `Foo@Bar.com` when the blacklist contains `foo@bar.com`.
